description: This file defines the interface AuthenticationResult which represents the outcome of an authentication process within the security module of the Ditto services gateway. It includes methods to check success, retrieve authorization context, headers, and failure reason.

classes.name: AuthenticationResult
classes.description: Interface representing the result of an authentication attempt, including success status, authorization context, headers, and failure reason.

methods.name: isSuccess
methods.description: Checks if the authentication was successful, returning true if it was.

methods.name: getAuthorizationContext
methods.description: Retrieves the authorization context if authentication succeeded; throws exception if not.

methods.name: getDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns the DittoHeaders associated with the authentication attempt, regardless of success or failure.

methods.name: getReasonOfFailure
methods.description: Provides the reason for failure if the authentication failed; throws exception if called when successful.
